Hi Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks for the demo today - Northridge is interested in moving forward but procurement will need a clear mutual action plan and the vendor setup items for our systems (we use Coupa). Can you send over a MAP that includes the procurement milestones (Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details) and a target close date?

- Vendor form (Coupa supplier set-up)
- Completed W-9 from Redwood

Hi Oliver - great to connect yesterday. Per our discussion, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (RNW_MAP_v1.xlsx) that outlines milestones, owners, and target dates. High level below and next steps at the bottom.

Draft MAP (high level) - Vendor Onboarding / Procurement milestone:
- Milestone: Contract signature (DocuSign)
  - Owner: Redwood (Rishi) / Northridge (Oliver)
  - Target date: 2026-05-28
  - Dependency: Procurement completes vendor form + W-9 on file

- Milestone: Coupa supplier setup / PO setup
  - Owner: Northridge Procurement (Procurement Team) / Redwood finance ops (Marissa)

  - Dependency: Completed vendor form, remit/banking details, and tax docs

- Milestone: Internal security sign-off & onboarding kickoff
  - Owner: Northridge IT / Redwood Customer Success (Laura)
  - Target date: 2026-06-04
  - Dependency: Security questionnaire + access plan

Attachments included: RNW_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (W-9 stub). Please note the W-9 is attached as a PDF stub for your procurement team; we can provide the full signed copy if you need an original.

Action items / next steps:
1) Oliver / Procurement: confirm whether you need Redwood set up as a supplier in Coupa or via a punchout/portal; if Coupa, please share supplier form URL or vendor creation email.
2) Oliver: fill vendor form and return (or invite redwood vendor contact to complete) - we can provide banking instructions once form requests them.
3) Rishi: will send the DocuSign for signature and copy of the final SOW once procurement constraints are confirmed.
4) Laura (CS): will own onboarding kickoff once procurement & security are complete.

Can we plan a 20-min procurement alignment call tomorrow (5/20) at 11am PT? If that works, I'll calendar invite and include our finance ops.

Thanks - Marissa
